objective: Close public/anonymous/member direct RPC access to four unguarded internal church-role helper functions while retaining trusted owner and service_role call chains.
productionBaselineEvidence: 2026-11-19 production DB read-only audit: 544 public tables all RLS enabled; four helper SECURITY DEFINER functions callable by anonymous or authenticated clients and lacked direct auth checks; two helpers are postgres-owned internal callers. Exact targeted ACL migration applied live and independently verified anon=false, authenticated=false, service_role=true for all four, security cron active, all Finance V3 money switches still OFF.
chosenApproach: Revoke PUBLIC, anon and authenticated EXECUTE only for four privileged internal helper RPCs; retain service_role and Postgres function owner access. No account, user, role records or application bundles changed.
selectionRationale: The helpers accepted caller-supplied role/scope/user IDs and could bypass table RLS. Tight role-based EXECUTE revocation blocks direct external app clients without replacing validated internal function code.
alternativeApproaches: Blanket revoke on hundreds of RPCs: rejected because it can break legitimate BUKLOD features.
Client-only validation: rejected because external clients can bypass app UI and call public RPCs.
Rewrite both internal caller flows urgently: rejected pending focused functional testing; permissions-only hotfix is safer.
preserveBehaviors: Existing authenticated app sessions, onboarding UI, Wall, Connect, ads and navigation remain unmodified.
Server-owned internal role setup, trusted worker service_role access and all existing finance switches/ledger balances remain unchanged.
Season 2 code and production Android OTA remain untouched.
acceptanceChecks: Four internal helpers reject anon/authenticated EXECUTE and preserve service_role.
Live production read-only privileges check matches migration intended ACL without modifying any records.
RLS and emergency security scanner remain active, finance switches remain OFF.
Required Engineering Accountability source CI passes; no app OTA or new native build.
